text.en:
Any provision of law, decree, rules and regulations to the contrary notwithstanding, the tax
exemptions granted to the Philippine Communications Satellite Corporation under Republic Act No. 5514 is
hereby restored.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
